version.changelog:
vrbo-search 1.1.0

- Expanded SKILL.md documentation with a platform × endpoint support matrix to clarify which features each OTA supports.
- Documented async job handling, polling, partial/failed results, and guidance on interpreting empty results and failed jobs.
- Added details and caveats around pagination, external IDs, platform limitations, and rate limiting.
- Updated tags/metadata to use category: "integrations" instead of "travel".
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.

llm.summary: This appears to be a legitimate travel-search integration, but it tells the agent to persist an API key across future sessions without clear secret-storage safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Internet access, a StayingAPI bearer token, and transmission of travel search details to api.stayingapi.com are disclosed and purpose-aligned for a live travel search API.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions only, with no executable installer, bundled code, dependencies, hooks, or background workers.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly scoped to user-requested stay searches, but the documentation includes adjacent endpoint support and cross-platform price/listing/review context beyond a narrow Vrbo-only search workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The auth guide instructs the agent to make STAYINGAPI_KEY available in every future session using a shell profile or runtime config, but does not require explicit consent, a secret manager, owner-only permissions, limited scope, or rotation guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is framed as Vrbo search and does document how to filter with platforms=vrbo, while also disclosing that StayingAPI can normalize results across Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, and Google Hotels.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the credential setup before installing. Prefer the MCP/OAuth flow or a sandbox/session-only key for evaluation, and avoid putting a live STAYINGAPI_KEY in a broad shell profile unless permissions and access are tightly controlled. If you only want Vrbo results, make sure the agent sends platforms=vrbo.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The broader cross-platform capability is visible in the skill description and body; it is a scoping note rather than evidence of hidden behavior, though users wanting only Vrbo should ensure platforms=vrbo is used.
[E1] expected: Sending the bearer token and user-provided travel search parameters to api.stayingapi.com is disclosed and necessary for the API integration; I found no unrelated destination or covert exfiltration path.
[T09] unexpected: Credential use is expected, but persistent storage across future sessions without concrete secret-storage safeguards is under-scoped for a potentially live, billable API key.
